title: Google & Meta Ads Executive
description:
**Role: Performance Marketer**

**JOB OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a Performance Marketer with 1–2 years of hands\-on experience in Google Ads and Meta Ads. The candidate should be able to manage paid campaigns, generate quality leads, analyze campaign performance, and optimize campaigns to achieve business goals.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Plan, set up, manage, and optimize Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

· Manage campaign budgets and ensure efficient ad spending.

· Monitor CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversions, and ROI.

· Conduct keyword, audience, and competitor research.

· Create and test different ad copies, creatives, audiences, and campaign strategies.

· Analyze campaign performance and prepare regular reports.

· Optimize campaigns to improve lead quality, conversions, and ROI.

· Set up and monitor conversion tracking, pixels, and events.

· Coordinate with the creative and content team for ad creatives and requirements.

· Stay updated with the latest trends and updates in Google and Meta advertising.

· Manage multiple campaigns and achieve performance targets.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

· Hands\-on experience with Google Ads.

· Hands\-on experience with Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram).

· Good understanding of lead generation and conversion campaigns.

· Basic knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.

· Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

· Data\-driven approach and attention to detail.

· Good communication and reporting skills.

**EXPERIENCE**

· 1–2 years of relevant experience in Performance Marketing / Digital Marketing.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

· Growth\-oriented work environment.

· Opportunity to work on real\-world performance marketing campaigns.

· Exposure to multiple industries and campaigns.

· Learning and career growth opportunities.

· Performance\-based growth and incentives.

Location: Sector\-62, Noida

Pay: ₹23,000\.00 \- ₹24,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have Experience in Google ads?
* Do you have Hands\-on experience with Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram)?
* Do you have understanding of lead generation and conversion campaigns?
* Your current location?
* Are you comfortable with the office timings (12 Pm to 9 Pm)?

Experience:

* Performance Marketer: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:

* Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Preferred)

title: Academic counselor
description:
**Date posted:** 7 September 2026

**Pay:** ₹20,000\.00\-₹30,000\.00 per month

Job Description:

About Sky Education Group

Sky Education Group is an education counselling and enrollment partner working with **28\+ universities across India**. We help students and working professionals choose the right **Online \& Distance UG and PG programmes** based on their academic background, career goals and requirements.

We are looking for an **experienced Academic Counsellor** who has already worked in the **Online/Distance Higher Education / EdTech admission sales domain** and can start handling leads with minimal training.

This is NOT a Fresher Position.

We are specifically looking for candidates who already understand:

* Online \& Distance Education
* UG \& PG admission counselling
* University/course comparison
* B2C lead handling
* Telephonic counselling
* Follow\-up and objection handling
* Admission conversion
* CRM/lead management
* Closing the admission cycle

Key Responsibilities

* Handle **fresh and existing leads** through telephone calls, WhatsApp and other communication channels.
* Understand the student's **education, career goals, work experience and course requirements**.
* Counsel students for Online \& Distance UG/PG programmes such as:
* **BBA**
* **BCA**
* **B.Com**
* **MBA**
* **MCA**
* Other relevant UG/PG programmes
* Explain and compare universities, programmes, eligibility, fees, admission process and other relevant details.
* Counsel students regarding programmes offered through leading universities such as **NMIMS, LPU, Amity, Chandigarh University, Manipal University** and other partner universities.
* Handle student objections related to **fees, university selection, course validity, programme structure, placements, admission process and competitors**.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with interested prospects and move them towards admission.
* Coordinate with the admission/operations team until the student's admission process is successfully completed.
* Maintain accurate lead and follow\-up information in the CRM.
* Achieve **monthly admission and revenue targets**.
* Maintain high\-quality counselling while focusing strongly on **conversion and closures**.

What We Are Looking For **Mandatory :**

* **6months\-1year of relevant experience** in Online Education / Distance Education / EdTech admission sales.
* Must have experience selling **Online/Distance UG \& PG programmes**.
* Candidates who have previously worked with **Online University, EdTech, University Enrollment Partner, Education Consultancy or similar organizations** are preferred.
* Strong understanding of the **Online Education admission process**.
* Proven experience in **B2C telephonic counselling and sales conversion**.
* Comfortable handling a high volume of calls and follow\-ups.
* Strong communication skills in **Hindi \& English**.
* Strong convincing, negotiation and objection\-handling ability.
* Comfortable working with sales targets.
* Candidate should be able to **start handling leads with minimal training**.

**We are NOT looking for**

❌ Freshers  
❌ Candidates without EdTech/Online Education experience  
❌ School counsellors with no admission\-sales experience  
❌ Candidates who have only handled offline college admissions  
❌ Candidates looking only for a non\-target\-based counselling role

Who Will Be a Strong Fit?

Someone who has previously worked as:

* Academic Counsellor
* Admission Counsellor
* Education Counsellor
* Senior Academic Counsellor
* Career Counsellor – EdTech
* Inside Sales Executive – EdTech
* Online Education Counsellor
* University Admission Counsellor

and has **actually converted Online/Distance Education leads into admissions**.

Interview

First Floor, Office No. 01  
B\-33, Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh – 201301

* Leave encashment

* Which universities have you personally handled/sold programmes for?

title: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager - Supply Chain Management
description:
* Non Medical
* 5\-10 years
* Sarvodaya Hospital, Greater Noida West (Noida Extension)

### **Job Description**


**Key Responsibilities**


**Procurement \& Supply Management**


* Plan, organize, and supervise the procurement of all hospital\-related materials and services.
* Ensure timely procurement of medical and non\-medical items to avoid stock\-outs.
* Monitor purchase requisitions and convert them into purchase orders within defined timelines.
* Coordinate with user departments to understand procurement requirements and priorities.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of critical items required for patient care and hospital operations.

**Vendor Management**


* Identify, evaluate, and empanel new vendors as per hospital procurement policies.
* Conduct periodic vendor performance reviews based on quality, pricing, delivery timelines, and service support.
* Negotiate prices, payment terms, annual rate contracts, and supply agreements.
* Maintain strong relationships with approved suppliers and manufacturers.

**Cost Control \& Budget Management**


* Monitor procurement costs and identify opportunities for cost savings.
* Conduct comparative analysis and market surveys for procurement decisions.
* Ensure purchases are made within approved budgets and financial guidelines.
* Participate in annual budgeting and procurement planning exercises.

**Inventory Coordination**


* Coordinate with stores, pharmacy, biomedical, engineering, and user departments for inventory management.
* Monitor consumption trends and reorder levels.
* Assist in reducing non\-moving, slow\-moving, and expired inventory.
* Ensure optimum stock levels are maintained without overstocking.

**Compliance \& Documentation**


* Ensure compliance with NABH standards, statutory requirements, and hospital procurement policies.
* Maintain accurate procurement records, purchase orders, contracts, quotations, and vendor documentation.
* Participate in internal and external audits and ensure closure of audit observations.
* Ensure procurement processes follow transparency and ethical business practices.

**Equipment \& Capital Purchases**


* Coordinate procurement of medical equipment and capital assets.
* Obtain technical specifications and comparative statements from concerned departments.
* Support installation, commissioning, warranty tracking, and vendor service coordination.

**Team Management**


* Supervise and guide purchase executives and procurement staff.
* Allocate work and monitor departmental performance.
* Conduct training and development initiatives for team members.
* Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, and efficiency.

**Qualifications**


* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Materials Management, Operations, or Hospital Administration preferred.
* Certification in Materials Management or Supply Chain Management will be an added advantage.

**Experience**


* 7\- 10 years of experience in procurement and supply chain management.
* Minimum 3 \- 5 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial role in a multi\-speciality hospital.
### **Key Skills**


* Supply Chain Management Procurement Management Inventory Control Vendor Management Logistics Management Cost Optimization MIS \& Reporting
### **Walk In**


* No

**Job Profile:** Software Implementer

**Work Location:** Noida

**Work Experience:** 0\-1 Year

**Monthly CTC:** Rs. 18k  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**  

**ERP Deployment**
* Plan and execute on\-site implementation of the School ERP system, including system setup, configuration, and integration with existing systems.
* Collaborate with school administrators and IT teams to ensure proper installation and data migration.

**Customization**
* Tailor the School ERP system to meet the specific needs of the school, including grading, attendance, scheduling, and reporting modules.
* Configure user roles, permissions, and access levels based on the institution’s requirements.

**Training**
* Provide hands\-on training to school staff, including teachers, administrative personnel, and IT staff, on how to use the ERP system efficiently.
* Create user guides, training materials, and conduct workshops to facilitate ease of use.

**Support**
* Offer on\-site technical support during the implementation phase to troubleshoot and resolve any issues that arise.
* Provide ongoing support and follow\-up to ensure the system continues to meet the needs of the school.

**Documentation**
* Document the implementation process and report any challenges or feedback for future improvements.
* Ensure all project milestones are met and deliver regular status reports to the project management team.

**Client Coordination**
* Liaise with school management to understand their specific needs and provide solutions accordingly.
* Communicate any issues, concerns, or required modifications to the development team.


**Required Skills Set**


* Strong knowledge of ERP systems, particularly school\-focused ERP solutions.
* Experience in system setup, configuration, and deployment is crucial.
* Ability to integrate the ERP system with other existing systems used by the school.
* Knowledge of configuring user roles, permissions, and access levels to align with institutional policies.
* Experience in documenting implementation processes, challenges, and outcomes.
* Ability to provide on\-site technical support, addressing issues that arise during and after deployment.
* Ability to train school staff, including teachers, administrative personnel, and IT staff, on the ERP system.
* Strong problem\-solving skills to address any technical challenges that arise during the ERP deployment.


**NOTE**


* Looking for immediate joiners.
* There will be a bond of 1 Year.
